overview.description: The Roundhill AMD WeeklyPay ETF (AMDW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. stock (AMD) AMDW was launched on Jul 24, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
